description: This Java class defines a Spring Boot REST controller for a preview stub of catalog-related endpoints. It provides mock responses for listing categories and retrieving specific category details, mainly used when downstream catalog services are unavailable, facilitating front-end or gateway development/testing.

classes.name: PreviewCatalogController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller providing preview stub endpoints for catalog categories, used during development or offline testing.

methods.name: listCategories
methods.description: Handles GET requests for listing categories with pagination, returning a stubbed paged response.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Handles GET request for retrieving a specific category by ID, returning a stubbed category or a default if not found.

methods.name: stubCategoriesFor
methods.description: Provides a list of predefined stub categories for a given store ID.
